item.title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Towards Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
item.description:
BI‑Agent uses large language models to automatically identify tables, transform data, and build joins needed to answer business questions, eliminating the manual steps in traditional BI. The authors created a benchmark (BI‑Bench) to evaluate such systems, showing that LLM‑driven workflows can match or exceed human performance on common BI tasks. This shows a way to reduce data‑prep effort in BI tools like Power BI and Tableau.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud data services, here is what to do: 1) check if your BI platform can integrate LLM APIs for automated table discovery and transformations; 2) pilot the LLM‑driven workflow on a small dataset to gauge accuracy; 3) monitor performance and adjust compute resources to handle the extra inference load.

item.title: [News] GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models
item.description: Microsoft Research has released GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, efficient pathology foundation models that reduce computational demands while preserving performance, enabling larger population-scale studies.

item.title: [News] Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
item.description: Google is testing a new Gemini‑powered checkout experience on the Walmart‑owned Flipkart platform in India. The feature allows users to purchase select products directly through Gemini and AI Mode, with a wider rollout expected later in October.

item.title: [News] Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
item.description: Blue Cross Blue Shield reports that AI-driven tools in hospitals increased healthcare spending by $942M over two years. This highlights a rising trend in AI-related cost escalation within the industry.

item.title: [News] I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
item.description: A tech entrepreneur has created an interactive digital avatar of himself that can discuss venture fraud, highlighting the emerging trend of AI-generated personal clones.

item.title: [News] Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot
item.description: Microsoft has launched an enhanced Copilot suite featuring Home, Code, and Autopilot, integrating AI capabilities across its productivity tools. This expansion aims to streamline workflow creation, automate code generation, and provide intelligent guidance within familiar Microsoft applications.
